Raw_customers is an SCD2 table. 30 customers have two rows: the current one (is_current=True, valid_from 2025-01-01) and a historical one (is_current=False, valid_from 2023-06-01). The join in gold_region_daily fans out those customers' transactions, which explains 5415 vs 4699.

The fix is to keep only current rows in silver_customers. Every one of the 200 customers has exactly one current row, since is_current=True appears 200 times across 200 distinct customer_ids. That makes the filter unambiguous.

One check on the choice between current and as-of-transaction-date region: the historical rows are valid from 2023-06-01 and the current rows from 2025-01-01. All transactions are in January 2026, after both valid_from dates, so the current row applies to every transaction. Filtering on is_current is correct.

Fanout check: 5415 - 4699 = 716, which is plausible for 30 customers with about 24 transactions each. The other joins are unaffected: merchants are unique.

The silver_customers columns stay the same, customer_id and region.
